Through this unique initiative, both generations create genuine connections and learn from each other. Meeting once a week over the span of eight weeks, these S&S Pairs share experiences, insights, and stories that bridge the gap between age groups. Time is also made for each generation’s participants to get to know one another, forming greater community, support networks, and friendships!
